issues.description: Timing side-channel in authenticate: the combined `if not user or not user.is_active:` guard returns a 401 without invoking bcrypt (~0ms), while a wrong-password path invokes bcrypt (~100ms). An external observer can infer whether a username exists or is active by measuring response latency.
issues.fix_instruction: Acceptable at V2 internal scale — DS-018 does not mandate constant-time login. No code change required. Document as a known limitation if a future public-facing release occurs. Mark closed.

issues.description: LLD authenticate.raises includes 'HTTPException 403 account deactivated' but plan.json scope ('401 if not found or inactive') and TC-192 (should_raise: HTTPException(status_code=401)) both specify 401. Implementation correctly follows plan.json and TC-192. The LLD raises[] field is a documentation error — not an implementation defect.
issues.fix_instruction: No change to auth_service.py needed. Update lld.json authenticate.raises[1] from 'HTTPException 403 account deactivated' to 'HTTPException 401 inactive account' at next /ases-prd-update or schema maintenance pass.

notes: All 5 methods match plan.json spec and LLD signatures.
commit() at service layer is consistent with the established S1 pattern (e.g. SupplierService.create_supplier).
NotFoundError from BaseRepository.update propagates to the global handler (errors.py register_error_handlers → 404) — correct by architecture.
Password hashed before persist; no JWT details in error messages; no raw SQL.
UserUpdate.role: str|None (no Pydantic literal constraint) is a schemas/auth.py (T-069) issue, out of scope for T-071.
